verdict.rationale: Claude Design can apply a team's design system automatically across projects and sync design-system context via '/design-sync' from Claude Code, suggesting some cross-project consistency, but there is no evidence of a true shared-library mechanism (publishing reusable components/styles with versioned, controlled updates propagating when a source library changes) as in dedicated design tools. Missing for 10: library publishing workflow, update/versioning notifications when source components change, and independent confirmation of cross-project sync behavior.
